title: Switch bridge MCP transport from stdio to HTTP+SSE
description:
The bridge MCP server (McpServer.java) uses stdio transport — hand-rolled JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout pipes. This works but makes timeouts awkward (requires select() on raw pipe fds) and complicates test mocking (mocks need os.pipe() instead of BytesIO).

Switching to HTTP+SSE transport would give us natural request timeouts via HTTP, simpler test mocking (just mock HTTP calls), and alignment with the standard MCP transport that most clients expect.

Java side: replace BufferedReader(System.in)/PrintWriter(System.out) with an HTTP server. The official Java MCP SDK (modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk) supports this. Alternatively, use JDK's built-in com.sun.net.httpserver.

Python side: replace Popen stdin/stdout pipes with HTTP requests. The mcp Python SDK already supports HTTP+SSE. BridgeSession._rpc() becomes a simple HTTP POST with a timeout= kwarg.

Port management is already solved — port.py has find_available_port() with fcntl locking.
